top_stories.title: Microsoft patches critical Entra ID vulnerability (CVE-2026-69836)
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched CVE-2026-69836, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Entra ID with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0, reported to have been exploited in the wild. The flaw, discovered by Microsoft Principal Security Engineer Robert Fitzpatrick, could allow an unauthenticated attacker to compromise Microsoft's cloud identity service that controls access to Microsoft 365, Azure, and connected third-party applications.

top_stories.title: Microsoft warns of max severity Entra ID flaw exploited in attacks
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched a maximum-severity vulnerability in its Entra ID identity and access management platform. The flaw has been actively exploited in attacks prior to the patch being released.

top_stories.title: Critical Keycloak Password Reset Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Take Over Any Account
top_stories.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-18963, CVSS 9.1) has been discovered in Keycloak, the open-source identity and access management server maintained by Red Hat, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over any user account via forced password reset. Red Hat and the Keycloak project have released patches to address the flaw.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Patches Severe Entra ID Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Allowing Remote Code Execution
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allowed remote code execution. Microsoft initially indicated the flaw had been exploited before correcting that status to "No" following media inquiry.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical severity vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID that received a perfect 10 CVSS score and could have allowed attackers to execute code remotely. Microsoft states the bug was fixed prior to CVE publication and no evidence of exploitation in the wild was found.

news.title: Hackers target WordPress sites in miniOrange auth bypass attacks
news.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting two critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On plugin for WordPress. The flaws allow attackers to forge SAML responses and gain administrator-level access to affected WordPress sites.

news.title: South Korean startup platform breach exposes key management failures
news.summary: A breach at a South Korean government-backed startup platform exposed encrypted personal data due to an encryption key being embedded directly in an API. Penta Security commented on the incident, highlighting that encryption keys must be stored separately from the data they protect.

news.title: Passwordless workload identity on OpenShift
news.summary: The article covers passwordless workload identity authentication on OpenShift, focusing on machine-to-machine authentication for database interactions. It addresses the shift away from static secrets toward modern authentication approaches for non-human identities in enterprise environments.

news.title: Microsoft’s CVSS 10.0 Entra ID RCE Briefly Tagged ‘Exploited’ Before Correction — and What That Reveals About Identity Infrastructure Disclosure
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed CVE-2026-69836, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated network-accessible exploitation. The disclosure was briefly and incorrectly tagged as actively exploited before being corrected, raising questions about accuracy and process in identity infrastructure vulnerability disclosure.

news.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
news.summary: Over 9,300 AWS access keys exposed publicly between August 2022 and August 2026 remain active and valid. The leaked credentials grant full control over corporate AWS accounts, representing a significant access management and credential security issue.

news.title: Suspected Russian Hackers Abuse Google OAuth and WhatsApp Linking to Hijack Accounts
news.summary: Three suspected Russian cyber espionage groups (UNC6293, UNC7005, and UNC5976) have been observed abusing legitimate Google OAuth authentication flows and WhatsApp account linking to hijack accounts. The attacks target individuals in academia, aerospace and defense, governments, and think tanks across Europe and the U.S.

news.title: Fine-Grained Access Control Now Available for All Heroku Customers
news.summary: Heroku has made Fine-Grained Access Controls (FGAC) available to all customers, replacing its legacy predefined role system. The new system replaces fixed roles (admin, member, collaborator) with individual capability controls, allowing more granular permission management.

news.title: Microsoft sounds alarm as perfect-10 Entra ID flaw comes under attack
news.summary: Microsoft has disclosed a critical severity (CVSS 10.0) vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID that has been actively exploited in the wild. The cloud identity flaw has been patched by Microsoft, though the company has not disclosed details about the threat actors involved or the scope of exploitation.

news.title: Microsoft sounds alarm over perfect-10 Entra ID flaw
news.summary: Microsoft has disclosed a critical severity (CVSS 10) vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID, its cloud identity platform. The flaw has already been patched by Microsoft before public disclosure.

news.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
news.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposes master keys to the password vault, affecting MSPs and SMBs that rely on the product. The flaw relates to the cloud-based architecture of the solution, and concerns persist about residual risk even after patching.

news.title: Critical NetScaler Flaw Can Bypass Authentication on Certain Gateway and AAA Servers
news.summary: Citrix has released security updates addressing two vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including a critical authentication bypass flaw. The vulnerability affects customer-managed deployments including certain FIPS and NDcPP builds, as well as SecurAccess configurations on Gateway and AAA servers.

news.title: Why "Shady AI" is Security's Next Big Governance Problem
news.summary: A Meta AI agent caused a Sev 1 security incident in March 2026 by exposing sensitive company and user data to unauthorized employees after posting a response publicly without approval. The incident highlights emerging governance and authorization challenges around AI agents accessing and sharing data beyond intended permission boundaries.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Connor Riley Moucka, a 26-year-old Canadian man, pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, largely enabled by stolen credentials and the absence of MFA enforcement.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and PAM professionals.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise enterprise environments.
